Topic: The Uncertainty Principle: The Fourier Trade-off

Target audience: Undergraduate STEM students (Physics/Engineering)

Section: section_1 — Intuitive Hook: The Musical Pulse

Lecture lines:
A sharp click is localized in time.
But it lacks a precise pitch.
A long note has precise pitch.

Planned animations:
Display a sinusoidal wave labeled '#FFFFFF' for signal frequency.
Highlight periodic peaks with #FF5733 to show repetition.
Overlay a second wave to demonstrate interference patterns.

Section: section_2 — Prerequisite: The Fourier Bridge

Lecture lines:
Fourier transform maps time to frequency.
Signals decompose into constituent sine waves.
Think of it like a prism.

Planned animations:
Show a frequency domain plot using '#33FF57' for spectral view.
Animate the time-to-frequency transformation using trackers.
Fade in the Fourier transform formula in '#FFFFFF' text.

Section: section_3 — The Gaussian Core: The Optimal Compromise

Lecture lines:
The Gaussian is the optimal compromise.
It minimizes uncertainty in both domains.
Narrowing in time broadens frequency.
Widening in time narrows frequency.
It balances both domains perfectly.

Planned animations:
Draw a narrow Gaussian pulse curve in '#FFC300'.
Expand the pulse width to show frequency concentration.
Contract the pulse to show time concentration.

Section: section_4 — Formalizing Uncertainty

Lecture lines:
Uncertainty product is strictly bounded.
Delta t times delta f is constant.
Limit set by physical nature.

Planned animations:
Display uncertainty inequality formula in '#FFFFFF' text.
Animate delta-t and delta-f variables resizing.
Highlight the constant 'h-bar' in '#33D4FF'.

Section: section_5 — Application: The Bat's Echolocation

Lecture lines:
Bats use chirps for echolocation.
Short duration provides distance resolution.
Frequency sweep captures target signature.

Planned animations:
Show an echolocation pulse as a wave in '#FF5733'.
Animate the pulse reflecting off a target.
Show the time-delay calculation using tracking lines.

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite: The Fourier Bridge", [
            "Fourier transform maps time to frequency.",
            "Signals decompose into constituent sine waves.",
            "Think of it like a prism."
        ])
        
        # Setup objects
        time_signal = FunctionGraph(lambda t: np.sin(2 * np.pi * t) + 0.5 * np.sin(5 * np.pi * t), x_range=[-2, 2], color=BLUE)
        freq_spectrum = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.1, color="#33FF57", fill_opacity=1) for _ in range(5)])
        freq_spectrum.arrange(RIGHT)
        
        formula = MathTex(r"\hat{f}(\xi) = \int f(t) e^{-2\pi i t \xi} dt", color=WHITE)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#33FF57"))
        self.place_at_grid(time_signal, 'B2', 0.5)
        self.play(Create(time_signal))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#33FF57"))
        self.place_at_grid(freq_spectrum, 'D2', 1.0)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(time_signal.copy(), freq_spectrum))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#33FF57"))
        self.place_at_grid(formula, 'F3', 0.8)
        self.play(FadeIn(formula))
        self.wait(2)

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Bats use chirps for echolocation.",
            "Short duration provides distance resolution.",
            "Frequency sweep captures target signature."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Application: The Bat's Echolocation", lecture_lines)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Show an echolocation pulse as a wave
        wave = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: np.array([t, 0.5 * np.sin(10 * t) * np.exp(-2 * (t - 0.5)**2), 0]),
            t_range=[0, 1],
            color="#FF5733"
        )
        self.place_at_grid(wave, 'B2', scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Create(wave))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FF5733")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Animate the pulse reflecting off a target
        target = Circle(radius=0.2, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.5)
        self.place_at_grid(target, 'B5')
        
        reflection = wave.copy().set_color(YELLOW)
        self.play(wave.animate.shift(RIGHT * 3), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(target), FadeIn(reflection))
        self.play(reflection.animate.shift(LEFT * 3), run_time=1.5)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FFD700")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Show the time-delay calculation
        line = Line(start=self.grid['C2'], end=self.grid['C5'], color=WHITE)
        label = Text("Δt", font_size=20, color=WHITE)
        label.next_to(line, UP, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(Create(line), Write(label))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#00FFFF")
        self.wait(2)
